name: Ring of Self Movement
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 9th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of telekinesis and functions as such. However, when used to bull rush a sentient target (any creature with a Wisdom score), the wearer becomes the target of the bull rush instead.

This ring can only be removed by the casting of remove curse upon it which renders the ring non-magical.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of telekinesis

Identification DC 34
False Identification DC 24
